name: Orbit Bloom: Garden Arcade
subtitle: Swipe, farm & race among stars
promotionalText: Grow a little world among the stars. Swipe botanical circuits, craft TNT, farm roses and apples, and race your harvest home. Your first 10 hints are free.
description:
A little world. Many ways to grow.

Welcome to Orbit Bloom, a connected garden arcade among the stars. Swipe flowers, leaves, apples, dewdrops and diamonds, grow a pocket farm, and race your harvest home.

BLOOM CIRCUITS
Swipe neighboring pieces to match three, or tap touching groups. Four in a line creates a Bomb, L and T formations create TNT, a seven-piece cross creates Mega Bomb, and five in a line creates Rainbow. Trigger powers on the board and chain nearby blasts. Clear frost and collect resources in 10–20 turns across 1,020 stages: twelve authored opening circuits and 1,008 generated expeditions.

FARM AND CRAFT
Plant roses and apples across six plots, water your crops, and harvest coins, compost and cargo. Crops grow while you are away. Craft stronger garden tools and complete permanent field tasks for hints, shuffles and power-ups.

HARVEST RALLY
Swipe your rover through three lanes. Dodge barriers, catch coins, and finish a 22-second delivery. Farm cargo adds a delivery bonus to your shared wallet.

YOUR LITTLE WORLD
Explore 102 swipeable island pages with ten ordered stops each. Complete stages to unlock the next stop, and enter farming or racing through places on your island. Spend earned stars on six garden restoration projects. Enjoy a softly animated 3D island, original dimensional botanical artwork, a friendly robot companion, animated coin collections, looping activity music and action sounds. Music, effects and haptics can be adjusted separately.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Start with ten free hints and three shuffles. More can be earned through field tasks or bought with earned game coins. Five normal puzzle lives regenerate one every 30 minutes, including while you are away. Winning returns a life. Farming and racing remain available while you wait.

Optional Apple in-app purchases offer coins, extra lives and a one-time First Bloom bundle. Purchased extra lives do not expire. Play as a guest or connect Game Center in Settings > Player & saved garden. Optional iCloud backup keeps your puzzle, farm, coins, lives and tools across devices. Use the same Game Center and iCloud accounts with iCloud Drive enabled. Check the last backup before changing devices. When gardens differ, choose which save to continue; balances are never added together. Guest progress stays on your device and can be lost if the app is deleted. No advertising or analytics.
reviewNotes:
No login is required. A short loading screen opens the island automatically. Tap Bloom circuits to begin. Swipe neighboring pieces to match three; Hint describes a valid swipe. Touching groups can also be tapped. Four in a line creates Bomb, L/T creates TNT, a seven-piece cross creates Mega Bomb, and five in a line creates Rainbow. Tap board powers to detonate and chain blasts. Inventory tools appear below the board.

The island uses in-world activity navigation and 102 island pages containing ten sequentially unlocked stages each (1,020 total). Swipe horizontally across the island; locked pages can be viewed but not started. Complete the current stage to unlock the next. Stages have 10–20 turns. The island is an original SceneKit scene; puzzle pieces use original dimensional rendered sprites.

Tap Farm & craft or Harvest rally on the island to enter activities. Swipe across the farm to open its tool shed. Crops grow by elapsed time. Swipe left/right on the race road to steer. The book opens permanent field tasks and formation diagrams. Tap the coin balance for supplies; swipe between packs. Back to your island returns from an activity.

Each first puzzle win gives 120 coins and one star. Two stars fund each of six ordered restoration projects. Five normal lives refill one every 30 minutes, and a win returns one. Purchased extra lives form a non-expiring reserve. Puzzle water is saved before animation, preserving earned farm water when interrupted without duplicating it.

Supplies offers four consumable coin packs, one consumable 5-life pack, and one non-consumable starter bundle. Verified StoreKit transactions are credited durably and idempotently. Restore checks non-consumable ownership. No advertising, analytics, tracking or publisher-operated game backend. Build 6 adds optional Game Center authentication and GameKit saved games in the player's private iCloud Drive container iCloud.com.orbitbloom.game. Settings > Player & saved garden opens Connect Game Center, Automatic iCloud backup and saved-garden choices. Guest play does not require login. Cloud backup requires the reviewer's Game Center and iCloud accounts and iCloud Drive enabled. No developer-issued demo credentials are needed. Separate account wallets and per-device backups prevent silent overwrites; a restore that omits an already credited local purchase is blocked. Purchases still use Apple StoreKit and do not require Game Center. The device retains local progress while offline, and backup errors are shown honestly. No gameplay data is sent to our website.
